newsitem.title: USA: ValuJet gets big demand for low fare - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: ValuJet gets big demand for low fare - WSJ.

text.p: ValuJet Inc said it was receiving heavy bookings in response to its special $19 fares promoting its renewed flights this week, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
The newspaper quoted its president, Lewis Jordan, as saying that the discount carrier had to call in additional reservations workers over the weekend in order to meet the demand.
ValuJet will begin flying on Monday after being grounded for three months by federal regulators after its flight 592 crashed in Florida in May, killing all 110 people aboard.
